description: North Macedonia: 270 displacements, 14 February - 16 February. According to the International Federation of the Red Cross, 270 people were displaced in Kičevo and municipalities in the Skopje region due to floods between 14-16 February. International Federation of the Red Cross (IFRC) - 16 February 2026
